remarks: Nestled in the highly sought-after Bemus Point School District, this beautiful 2.4-acre wooded parcel offers the perfect setting to build your dream home. Featuring approximately 251 feet of road frontage, the property is situated between two established residential properties, providing convenient access to utilities and a neighborhood feel while still offering privacy and a peaceful natural setting. A small stream meanders through the property, adding charm and character to the landscape. With mature trees and plenty of space to design your ideal home, this scenic lot presents a wonderful opportunity for those looking to build in a desirable location. Don’t miss your chance to own this picturesque piece of land!
